proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7636 pakṣin gives Prakrit pakkhi/pakkhia, Bengali pākhi and Oriya pakhī bird. Hajong pukhi, Bengali pakhi and Bishnupriya pakhiya/pahiya fit this family; source u/a, velar weakening in pahiya and the extended -iya form are retained as regional qualifications. The link does not assert an exact dictionary attestation for every variant or a settled local transmission route. Exact response: pahiya.
